title: Promoting online teaching through active learning strategies: applications and innovations
reason: Single-group pre/post/follow-up design on Blackboard: cognitive achievement test over time plus an attitude self-checklist. No platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to any outcome or construct.

extraction.n_quote: After three participants withdrew, 23 female participants remained in the “Methods of Teaching Physical Education and Self-Defense Sports” e-course
extraction.population: female higher-diploma students in physical education, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: none measured (Blackboard used as delivery platform only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: cognitive achievement test; attitudes toward online active learning (self-report)
extraction.notes: eta2 = 0.98 is the within-subject time effect on achievement, not an indicator-outcome relation; not extracted. Secondary: NOREL (attitudes are self-report only).
